Give the symbol ID of the function or method containing the call and the symbol ID of the function passed, one row per distinct pair.

Requested output columns: passing_symbol_id (string), passed_symbol_id (string).

filtered AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT

        SELECT s.symbol_id

      AND passed_symbol_id NOT IN (

        WHERE s.kind = 'function'

    )
      AND passing_symbol_id NOT IN (
